execution: Sequential rounds with CPU affinity 0-3; no live models or simulated network delay. Supplied usage is synthetic provider metadata. Timings have different work/outcomes for failed vs successful trials and must not be used as speedup ratios.

rounds.fixture: One exact-value edit. A scripted provider corrects its response only after host grammar feedback; repeated-malformed never corrects. Healthy replies are identical in both arms.
rounds.includes: Task execution and, on accepted tasks only, independent final integration. Failed trials do not perform integration; timings across different outcomes are not speedup evidence.
